name: ChannelEA2
summary: ChannelEA2 is a channel breakout Expert Advisor that identifies price channels and enters trades when price breaks out of the channel boundaries. It uses channel high/low levels to determine entry points and manages positions with stop loss and take profit based on channel width. The EA systematically trades breakouts from established price ranges.
summary_zh: ChannelEA2是一个通道突破型EA，通过识别价格通道并在价格突破通道边界时入场交易。它利用通道高低点确定入场位置，并根据通道宽度设置止损止盈。该EA系统化地交易已形成价格区间的突破。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于价格通道突破，当价格突破通道上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空。入场条件为价格收盘突破通道边界，通道由指定周期内的最高价和最低价构成。出场条件包括固定的止损止盈，止损设在通道对侧边界附近，止盈根据通道宽度倍数设定。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了风险控制参数但缺乏动态调整机制，整体策略逻辑清晰但较为简单。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on price channel breakouts, going long when price breaks above the upper channel boundary and short when it breaks below the lower boundary. Entry conditions require price to close beyond the channel boundaries, where the channel is formed by the highest high and lowest low over a specified period. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit, with stop loss placed near the opposite channel boundary and take profit set as a multiple of channel width. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or account equity-based calculation. Money management provides risk control parameters but lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms, making the overall strategy logic clear but relatively simplistic.

pros: 通道突破策略逻辑清晰易懂，适合趋势行情
使用通道宽度动态设定止损止盈，具有一定的适应性
策略参数较少，便于优化和调整
pros_en: Channel breakout strategy logic is clear and easy to understand, suitable for trending markets
Uses channel width to dynamically set stop loss and take profit, providing some adaptability
Few strategy parameters make it easy to optimize and adjust
cons: 通道突破在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的假突破信号
缺乏趋势过滤器，可能在横盘市场中频繁亏损
仓位管理较为简单，没有根据波动率或账户风险动态调整
cons_en: Channel breakouts easily generate frequent false signals in ranging markets
Lacks a trend filter, which may cause frequent losses in sideways markets
Position sizing is simplistic without dynamic adjustment based on volatility or account risk
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更大周期均线）以过滤横盘假突破
引入波动率自适应的仓位管理，根据ATR调整手数和止损距离
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or higher timeframe moving average) to filter out false breakouts in sideways markets
Introduce volatility-adaptive position sizing that adjusts lot size and stop distance based on ATR

risk_points: 缺乏横盘市场过滤机制，震荡行情中可能连续亏损
固定止损可能不适合所有市场波动环境
没有最大回撤控制或账户资金保护机制
risk_points_en: Lacks sideways market filtering mechanism, may suffer consecutive losses in ranging conditions
Fixed stop loss may not be suitable for all market volatility environments
No maximum drawdown control or account equity protection mechanism
